method: Enumerate every src Vue v-for; resolve direct relative/workspace public imports; manually classify collection/control/inline branches and follow complete-theme/protected-slot/renderless plugin composition. Direct import edges include public exports; they do not alone prove live runtime rendering. Scroll roots are source/CSS contracts, not measured browser geometry.
productionChains: apps/{userscript,tauri}/src/main.ts -> application built-in-themes -> MusicSourceWorkbench -> MusicWorkbenchThemeHost -> plugin-ui-vue/trusted ThemeHost -> theme definition.Root -> definition.views[activeViewId]

ClassicFavorites/ClassicQueue/ClassicPlaylists -> ClassicTrackCollection -> ClassicCollectionContent -> QueueTrackGrid -> TrackCardGrid slot; platform overview branch -> CollectionGrid. Non-collection fallback is separately recorded.
StudioFavorites/StudioQueue/StudioPlaylists -> StudioCollection -> StudioTrackTable -> native tr plus companion detail/control tr OR TrackCardGrid -> StudioStyledTrack.

createWorkbenchSpecialistFeatures -> injected renderless plugin Panel/Composer -> neutral controls -> each theme specialist view; TagDetailsPanel associations are slots supplied by TagManagementDialogs/StudioTagDialogs -> ReadonlyTrackCollection/StudioReadonlyTracks and ReadonlyPlaylistCollection/StudioReadonlyPlaylists (C24).

MusicWorkbenchThemeHost protected settings slots -> ExternalSourceSettings -> NativePluginInstallList and command result; apps/tauri App -> AccountSettingsPanel/AccountSettingsOverlay -> AccountList/platform/policy/connection/switch forms. Themes receive no account authority.
renderFunctions: ClassicRoot.ActivePage/PlayerView/SettingsView and StudioRoot.ActivePage/SettingsView each render a single selected definition view, not a collection.
createWorkbenchSpecialistFeatures renders one bound injected editor per specialist; growing children are in the inventoried controls/themes.
ui async-feature-component renders one resolved/loading/error view. TrackCardGrid and CollectionGrid render caller slots: inventory every slot producer, not only the wrapper.
openEquivalenceGates: Browser find-in-page and cross-window text selection after offscreen DOM removal (all virtual consumers).
Actual browser scroll-root resolution, focus, layout and all G01/G02/G03 runtime comparisons remain unmeasured.
